name: @endevre/entry-on-kitchen
description: Official JavaScript/TypeScript library for Entry on Kitchen API

scripts.release: npm version patch && git push origin main --tags
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && git push origin main --tags
scripts.release:major: npm version major && git push origin main --tags
scripts.release:beta: npm version prerelease --preid=beta && npm publish --tag beta
scripts.release:alpha: npm version prerelease --preid=alpha && npm publish --tag alpha

author: Endevre Technologies
